Package com.saicone.types.util

Class WrappedCollection<A,B>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedObject<A,B>
com.saicone.types.util.WrappedCollection<A,B>
Type Parameters:
A - the base type of object.
B - the type of object to represent A.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<B>, Collection<B>
Direct Known Subclasses:
WrappedList, WrappedQueue, WrappedSet
public class WrappedCollection<A,B> extends WrappedObject<A,B> implements Collection<B>
Represents a Collection of type A as a Collection of type B.
